_comment: Recipes for Phase 5 production (SIMULATION_SPEC.md §9, roadmap 5.1/5.2). Read by autoloads/production.gd. `building_type` keys into data/buildings.json — a recipe only ever runs at a COMPLETE building of that type, exactly one active batch at a time (Building.active_recipe/recipe_progress). `inputs`/`outputs` are good_id -> qty per batch, taken from and deposited into the *building's own inventory* (SIMULATION_SPEC.md §10 — no global pool): starting a batch consumes its inputs immediately, same 'per batch' framing the spec table uses. A recipe with inputs pulls them the same way a construction site pulls its build materials — autoloads/hauling.gd's 'production input delivery' scan (§10: 'a consuming building pulls from its own inventory; when short, it queues a haul task from the nearest store that holds the good'); a batch with no inputs (raw extraction — felling, quarrying) never needs one and can always start. `labour_hours` is the placeholder one-worker-at-skill-50 figure from §9's table. Chain so far: felling and quarrying (extraction, no chain building type needed) feed sawing (sawpit) — the first real link, timber -> sawn_timber, closing the loop that every construction site's build_materials already draws on. Charcoal-burning and everything past this wait on their own building types as later Phase 5 work needs them, a JSON entry each, zero code changes.
